# Bottle Lake Bikes - Full AI Site Summary

## Business Summary

Bottle Lake Bikes is a local bike servicing, repair, and sales business in Parklands, Christchurch, located near Bottle Lake Forest. The site says Bottle Lake Bikes works on mountain, road, gravel, commuter, and e-bikes, sells fully serviced second-hand bikes, and helps customers sell bikes directly or on commission.

Patrick is described as the person behind Bottle Lake Bikes. The About page says he has worked in the cycling industry as a service technician, a design engineer, and in product sourcing. The page also says he is happy to help with other gear and has experience working on scooters, prams, and wheelchairs.

Canonical site: https://bottlelakebikes.co.nz/

## Public Pages

- [Home](https://bottlelakebikes.co.nz/): Overview of servicing, repairs, bike sales, after-hours service, and customer reviews.
- [Repairs and Servicing](https://bottlelakebikes.co.nz/services.html): Service packages, add-ons, individual service pricing, and booking calls to action.
- [Buying and Selling](https://bottlelakebikes.co.nz/buying-selling.html): Refurbished bike sales, direct bike buying, and commission sales.
- [Our Brands](https://bottlelakebikes.co.nz/our-brands.html): Bike brands, parts, components, tyres, accessories, clothing, and gear available through Bottle Lake Bikes.
- [About](https://bottlelakebikes.co.nz/about.html): Background on Patrick, the business, and service approach.
- [Booking](https://bottlelakebikes.co.nz/booking.html): Online booking page for bike service.
- [Contact](https://bottlelakebikes.co.nz/contact.html): Contact details and contact form.

## Repairs and Servicing

The services page says Bottle Lake Bikes provides bike servicing with clear pricing and services all bikes including mountain, road, gravel, commuter, and e-bikes. It also says customers who are unsure what they need can book in and have the bike assessed on drop-off.

### Service Packages

- Drivetrain deep clean add-on: $39. Includes full removal of chain, cassette, and chainrings; deep clean of drivetrain components; reassembly and lubrication; replacement drivetrain parts fitted if required, with parts extra.
- General Service: $79. Includes brake tuning and adjustment, gear tuning, safety and bolt check, clean bike and wheels, adjust hubs and headset, inflate tyres, and chain lubrication.
- Full Service: $159. Includes everything in General Service plus cable lubrication or replacement with new parts extra, wheel truing and spoke tensioning, hub service, headset service, and bottom bracket service.

### Service Add-ons

- Fork lowers: $65 per unit, plus seals if required.
- Rear shock air can service: $65.
- Full suspension pivot clean and grease: $90, with bearing replacement available if required.
- Dropper post service: $60, plus parts if required.
- Brake bleed: $25 for Shimano/Tektro, $40 for SRAM, per brake.
- Tyre sealant refreshed: $8 per wheel.

### Individual Service Items

- Puncture repair or tyre replacement: $15.
- Brake tune: $15 per brake.
- Gear tune: from $25.
- Comprehensive safety check: $40.
- Bottom bracket service or replacement: $35.
- Fork lowers / rear shock air can service: $65, plus seals if required.
- Dropper post service: $60, plus parts if required.
- Wheel build: $90.
- Bar tape replacement: $25.

The services page says Bottle Lake Bikes can often get customers in for a service in 1-2 days and asks customers to use the booking form or call 021 0290 1656.

## Buying and Selling Bikes

The buying and selling page says Bottle Lake Bikes sells good quality, fully serviced bikes so customers can buy second-hand with confidence.

Selling options described on the site:

- Sell a bike directly to Bottle Lake Bikes for a simpler process and an upfront price.
- Sell a bike through Bottle Lake Bikes on commission. The site says Bottle Lake Bikes will service, clean, and polish the bike prior to sale.

Commission rates for bikes sold on a customer's behalf:

- Sales up to $600: 35% commission.
- Sales between $600 and $1500: 30% commission.
- Sales between $1500 and $3000: 25% commission.
- Sales over $3000: 20% commission.
- Minimum commission: $100.

The page says Bottle Lake Bikes will provide an estimated sale price before listing the bike.

## Brands and Parts

The brands page says Bottle Lake Bikes supplies bike brands for repairs, servicing, replacement parts, tyres, tubes, drivetrain components, brakes, wheels, workshop tools, riding gear, and accessories in Parklands, Christchurch.

Brand categories listed on the page:

- Bikes.
- Service parts.
- Tyres and wheels.
- Components.
- Accessories.
- Riding gear.

Brands listed on the page include Haro, Orange Bikes, Bombtrack Bikes, microSHIFT, Frictive, Hayes, Absolute Black, Wheels MFG, Hope, SKF, Vittoria, WTB, CST, Hutchinson, Pirelli, American Classic, E*thirteen, SUNringle, Lightweight, Tune, PNW, Reverse, HT Pedals, Brooks, Lizard Skins, Maxima, Zefal, Exposure, AXA, Beto, Pedro's, IceToolz, Geosmina, Back Country, Endura, 100%, Proviz, BoBike, Polisport, and Ryno Power.

The page asks customers looking for a specific bike brand, replacement part, tyre, tube, brake pad, drivetrain part, wheel component, or riding accessory in Christchurch to get in touch so Bottle Lake Bikes can check availability.

## Booking

Booking page: https://bottlelakebikes.co.nz/booking.html

The booking page says customers can call 021 0290 1656 for fastest service or book online. The online booking button links to Setmore:

https://bottlelakebikes.setmore.com/book?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bottlelakebikes.co.nz%2Fthanks-for-booking.html

The booking page says service turnaround is often same or next day.

- Footer note: after-hours appointments available on request.

## Public Site Structure Notes

This repository is a static HTML site. Public pages are root-level HTML files. Public static discovery files should also live at the repository root so they are served as:

The admin pages are excluded from this guide and from the sitemap.
